dc:title: Google review risk-score denominators: source audit and identification models — google-risk-velocity.csv

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Distinguishes attributed source aggregates from constructed models; never a Canadian case outcome.

columns.name: profiles
columns.dc:description: Source profile count in the labelled velocity row; selected correlation set.

columns.name: median_lifespan_days
columns.dc:description: Source creation-to-removal median among selected deleted reviews; not report-processing time.

columns.name: average_deletions_per_profile
columns.dc:description: Source cumulative deletions over the measurement window; not an annual rate.

columns.name: five_star_deleted_share_percent
columns.dc:description: Published percentage of a profile deleted-review set; not five-star share of every review on a profile.
